source.paraphrase: Name component inputs and outputs without string aliases, so the property name is the binding name.

invariants.why: An alias renames the binding at every use site, so a search for the property name misses the template that binds it.
invariants.fixHint: Drop the string argument: @Input() label. Rename the property itself when the public name must change.
invariants.avoid: The options-object form @Input({ alias }) is the same rename behind a key and is still banned.

source.paraphrase: Write route guards as functions returning CanActivateFn, not as classes implementing the CanActivate interface.

invariants.why: A class guard needs an injectable, a provider entry, and a canActivate method for one boolean. A function guard is the value the router calls.
invariants.fixHint: Export a const typed CanActivateFn: export const authGuard: CanActivateFn = () => true.
invariants.avoid: CanActivateChild is the same legacy shape for child routes, not a functional guard.

source.paraphrase: Standalone-era components declare one styleUrl string instead of the legacy styleUrls array.

invariants.why: The plural key is the legacy API. One stylesheet per component keeps the metadata a single string the tooling reads directly.
invariants.avoid: A single-entry array is still the plural key. The key, not the length, is what the rule bans.

source.paraphrase: Services fetch data through HttpClient, not the global fetch, so interceptors, typing, and tests cover every request.

invariants.why: Global fetch bypasses interceptors for auth headers and error handling, and its responses stay untyped.
invariants.fixHint: Inject HttpClient and call this.http.get<T>(url). Keep fetch, if ever needed, outside *.service.ts files.
invariants.avoid: globalThis.fetch is still global fetch. The receiver prefix does not route through HttpClient.

source.work: Angular dependency injection guide, injection context (https://angular.dev/guide/di/dependency-injection-context)
source.paraphrase: inject() works only in an injection context: field initializers, the constructor, factory functions and runInInjectionContext. Called elsewhere, such as in a lifecycle hook, it throws NG0203. effect() and takeUntilDestroyed() need the same context unless given an Injector or DestroyRef.

invariants.why: Lifecycle hooks run after construction, so inject(), effect() and argument-less takeUntilDestroyed() throw NG0203 at runtime instead of resolving a dependency.
invariants.fixHint: Inject into a field (private readonly service = inject(Service)) or create the effect in the constructor; inside a hook, pass takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef) or effect(fn, { injector: this.injector }).
invariants.avoid: A callback created inside the hook, such as a subscribe handler, runs even later and is still outside the context. runInInjectionContext and injector.runInContext wrappers are not matched.

source.paraphrase: HttpClientModule is deprecated; use provideHttpClient(withInterceptorsFromDi()) as providers instead. HttpClientTestingModule, HttpClientXsrfModule and HttpClientJsonpModule are deprecated in favor of provideHttpClientTesting() and the withXsrfConfiguration / withJsonpSupport features.

invariants.why: The NgModule wrappers are deprecated and slated for removal, and they keep the app on the module-based setup instead of the provider functions that standalone bootstrap uses.
invariants.fixHint: Replace the module with provideHttpClient(withInterceptorsFromDi()) in providers, or provideHttpClient() plus provideHttpClientTesting() in TestBed.
invariants.avoid: An import alias or a re-export from a shared file is still the deprecated module. Imports of provideHttpClient and HttpTestingController are not matched.

source.paraphrase: Avoid using effects for propagation of state changes (writing to signals). This can result in ExpressionChangedAfterItHasBeenChecked errors, infinite circular updates, or unnecessary change detection cycles; use computed or linkedSignal instead.

invariants.why: Writing to signals inside an effect() callback cascades reactive updates after change detection, risking circular loops and out-of-order state synchronization.
invariants.fixHint: Express derived state with computed(() => ...) or writable dependent state with linkedSignal(() => ...). Move imperative writes to event handlers.
invariants.avoid: Single-argument .set(...) and .update(...) calls inside an effect(...) callback are flagged as advisory warnings; multi-argument calls such as Map.prototype.set(k, v) and signal writes in event handlers outside effect() pass.
